evidence_quotes: Key topic: Construction on a protected watershed
Edificacao irregular inserida em lote de mananciais - APP
rationale: This TJSP decision concerns an irregular building constructed on a lot within a protected watershed and permanent preservation area (mananciais - APP), requiring submission of a regularization plan within six months and demolition of non-regularizable portions due to lack of a municipal building permit and ecosystem protection rules. Under the protocol, Brazilian watershed protection (mananciais) land-use/demolition enforcement cases are classified as WATER for mananciais_calibrated_label, UNCERTAIN for strict_service_access_label (as no direct water utility service or water abstraction/pollution adjudication is involved), and environmental_protection (explicitly covering manancial and APP) with involves_connection_or_informal_settlement = false.
